title: After the Rain
original_request: Create an example configuration of a short poem that uses all four (Object counting Algebra) operations using the "D:\indexer\projects\idx_0001_engine" workflow.

alphabet: Rain leaves silver on the street.
Night grows quiet. You are here.

interpretation.primitive: One occurrence of an exact whole line in the ordered alphabet.
interpretation.rendering: Visit reading_order and print each line as many times as its coordinate, with repeated copies adjacent. Omit zero-count lines.
interpretation.composition_rule: Matching line types reproduce that same type; different line types produce the empty configuration. T[i][j][k] is 1 exactly when i=j=k, and 0 otherwise. Consequently (x*y)[i]=x[i]*y[i].
interpretation.scope: This is a declared model of line multiplicities. Rendering order is external to configuration equality. Multiplication combines occurrence counts, not the meanings of sentences; no literary quality is certified.

steps.purpose: Join the opening couplet to an ending draft containing an extra last line.
Remove exactly one occurrence of the last line, yielding the four-line poem.
Apply two copies of the identity as a line-count multiplier, producing two of every line.
Find every q with q*[2,2,2,2]=[2,2,2,2]. The complete quotient set contains only the original poem.

requirements: Use addition, exact subtraction, multiplication, and complete right division through the existing engine dispatcher.
The four steps form one chain: each result is the next step's left operand.
Preserve the four exact whole lines and render the final poem in the declared reading order.
The final configuration has exactly one occurrence of every line.
Verify additive and multiplicative reconstruction and canonical encode/decode round trips.
Keep configuration pointers separate from persistent record IDs and retain the full quotient set.
